sn56.62:1.1: kho Bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo vāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti || mahāpathavim upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || ||
sn56.62:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti || aviññātāresu milakkhesu || pa
